entries.0b53df021fc8f638: The company puts forward a "Regional Revitalization Platform Concept" that supports regional revitalization with public-private collaboration as its engine, and it consists of two parts: a "Communication Platform" that supports information dissemination and interaction in local communities, and a "Solution Platform" that promotes DX in local communities. The government information magazine Waga Machi Jiten has achieved joint publication with more than 1,100 municipalities, and the digital signage Waga Machi NAVI has been installed in more than 300 locations through public-private collaboration. In addition, the company aims to increase consolidated net sales by improving employees' abilities and productivity through investment in human capital such as the introduction of AI training, reducing costs and expenses, and considering and carrying out alliances and M&A with companies where synergy effects with the group's businesses are expected, in order to expand its business domains.

entries.32fc01d95152c1f8: Its strength is that it has built up, over about 20 years, a business model of public-private collaborative government information magazines that it began in 2006 (Heisei 18), and has a record of joint publication with more than 1,100 of the approximately 1,700 basic municipalities nationwide.
